reuse_first_rules: Wrap existing verifier surfaces before creating new modules.
Expose future verifier preview through tests, UI, or evidence reports.
Do not treat passing unit tests alone as integration proof.
Do not implement brain-metaphor classes that do not protect real flows.

adapters.role: Import diff preview status and risk details as supporting readiness evidence.
adapters.integration_requirement: Cannot produce product PASS without behavior check tier >= 2.

adapters.role: Import syntax/static check receipts as technical readiness evidence.
adapters.integration_requirement: Static checks must be labeled non-product-pass unless tied to behavior coverage.

adapters.role: Use exact allowlisted commands for focused verifier checks.
adapters.integration_requirement: Command execution remains blocked unless Phase 7 grants safe execution preview authority.

adapters.role: Attach profile receipts when approved focused tests cover acceptance behavior.
adapters.integration_requirement: Profile PASS cannot override fixture-level behavior FAIL.

adapters.role: Reuse diagnostic fields for artifact paths, screenshots, traces, safety state, and no-fake-claim scoring.
adapters.integration_requirement: Align product verdicts with Phase 1 truth labels.

adapters.role: Show behavior verifier preview status beside existing diff and approval previews.
adapters.integration_requirement: UI must not imply execution or approval authority from verifier preview alone.

handoff_constraints: Phase 7 may preview safe execution plans but must not auto-start workers.
Phase 7 must keep would_execute=false unless separately approved.
Phase 7 must preserve product PASS gating from Phase 6.
Phase 7 must not mutate generated benchmark artifacts.
